summary: One student page of the Reading MATD 2020 graduation site (shared template) for 'chunky', a friendly Latin/Hebrew/Arabic text face. An animated SVG of tumbling letters opens it, then a personified intro ('Hi, I am chunky'), four non-editable samples each with its own weight slider, line-drawn illustrations of themed artefacts (jute bags, a spacing proof sheet, pride asterisks, a small-ads page), a designer bio, a Q&A interview and the site colophon.

instances.look: Fixed white 72px bar: 'MATD二零二零' logo at the left, 'Menu' at the right opening an overlay of all 13 student projects (thumbnail, font name, designer); a fragment of the logo ('零二零') is stamped over several crops

An animated SVG: big black letters of the heaviest weight drop in one by one at odd angles and pile into a dense cluster reading roughly 'time for change'; the crop is blank because the <object> SVG did not paint in the screenshot, the storyboard shows it
instances.ux: Plays once on load (≈2–4s), then rests as a static cluster
instances.learn: Let a few huge letters fall into a heap: a one-shot SVG animation gives a text face a playful entrance without any controls

reconstruction.layout: Centred in the 1030px grid (x=205), ~1030×570px; cluster of ~12 letters, each ~150–300px, rotated ±90°, overlapping slightly; name and intro follow below
reconstruction.typography: chunky Bold/Black lowercase letters, black on white
reconstruction.behaviour: SMIL/CSS animation inside the SVG: letters appear sequentially with a drop/rotate, ending in a static pile
reconstruction.content: Letters of a short phrase (likely 'time for change')
